title: Cosmic Spiral Dancers
description: A surreal vertical painting depicts three ethereal female figures with flowing dark hair and blue-purple silhouettes dancing along a swirling cosmic vortex. The vortex transitions from vibrant yellow, orange and blue spirals at the bottom through concentric circles into a large purple and gold swirling galaxy at the top, surrounded by stars, planets and flowing purple smoke-like forms.
prompt: Surreal vertical cosmic artwork showing three graceful female silhouettes with long flowing hair dancing upwards through a swirling energy vortex. The vortex begins with bright blue, yellow and orange spirals at the bottom, transitioning into concentric rings and culminating in a large vibrant purple, magenta and gold galaxy at the top filled with stars and planets. Ethereal purple smoke and energy flows frame the scene, vibrant fantasy colors, dynamic movement, mystical atmosphere.
